description:
Rates on a date

Every currency's official rate on `date` (default: the latest bulletin). TCMB: the indicative forex and banknote buying/selling rates in TRY, published at 15:30 Istanbul time on business days. ECB: the euro reference rates, published around 16:00 CET. A date without a bulletin (weekend, holiday) answers the latest one before it; `meta.date` says which. Use for the official (central-bank reference) exchange rate — e.g. "what is the USD/TRY rate", the TCMB rate, or a rate on a past date. These are not a bank's own buying/selling prices: for what a bank charges, use the bank exchange rate tools.

GET /v1/fx/rates on Currencies (SBX-FX). Costs 1 credit per call.

currencies.description: Comma-separated ISO 4217 codes to include, e.g. USD,EUR.

source.description: `tcmb` (default: Turkish central bank, TRY rates since 2005) or `ecb` (European Central Bank, EUR rates since 1999).
